e.s: tainted by vaccines

e.s: unvaccinated members in colony

e.s: unvaccinated liability
I have no vaccines. I am a risk to myself and to everyone around me.

e.s: minimally vaccinated
I have two vaccines. I am fulfilling my duty to keep the colony healthy.

e.s: mostly vaccinated
